title: Beyond the 956: Stephen Redic, 70, arrested after alleged polling-site confrontation in Laconia, New Hampshire
excerpt: Stephen Redic, 70, of Laconia, New Hampshire, was arrested and charged with misdemeanor simple assault and violation-level disorderly conduct after allegedly striking a Turning Point Action volunteer outside a Laconia polling site on Election Day. He is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Stephen Redic, 70, of Laconia, New Hampshire, was arrested after an alleged confrontation outside a Laconia polling site on Election Day, according to WorldStar and news reports.

WorldStar reported that Redic approached a Turning Point Action booth at the polling site to read a poem about wealthy people, that a debate followed, and that he allegedly yelled at an 18-year-old volunteer before striking him across the face. Police said they obtained video evidence and identified several witnesses, WorldStar reported.

Redic was arrested Wednesday and charged with misdemeanor simple assault and violation-level disorderly conduct, according to WorldStar. News reports identified the polling location as Woodland Heights School, the Ward 5 polling location in Laconia, and reported that Redic is due to be arraigned in Laconia on December 10.

The volunteer was not publicly named in the reports reviewed. Redic is presumed innocent until proven guilty, and the charges are allegations at this stage.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post, https://www.instagram.com/p/DfVDQTxHFqp/; The Sun, reporting the arrest, charges and December 10 arraignment.
